rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires a shot of any power, it must have a target that was scanned this very turn (age 0) and its gun must be pointing at that target within 3.0°; with no target, a stale scan, or a misaimed gun, it must not fire.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Proved: S2 holds (but battles show S3 violations)
explanation.summary: Verus proved the only rule it checked, S2: the robot fires only when it saw a target this turn (age 0) and the gun is aimed at it. In the battles, however, a different rule, S3, was reported broken from turn 2 (46 turns in the open arena, 258 in the city). The S3 rule text and spec were not provided, so I can't say what it requires or why the code breaks it.
